description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to shape the quality of patient care and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a leader who is passionate about clinical excellence and operational efficiency.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking to fill this critical position quickly with a qualified professional ready to make an immediate impact. Join a team committed to providing exceptional care and a positive work culture.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong knowledge of long-term care regulations and standards of practice
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
Ability to manage and mentor a diverse nursing team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, commensurate with experience.
